user_query: I'm a developer working on an NFT project and I need to gather data on the top NFT collections on OpenSea. Can you fetch the rankings, including the names of the collections, their total quantity, and the number of owners? Also, provide me with the channel playlists and video comments for a specific YouTube channel.

TaskList.description: Fetch the rankings of the top NFT collections on OpenSea, including their names, total quantities, and number of owners.
Retrieve the channel playlists for the specified YouTube channel.
Get the video comments for videos in the YouTube channel playlists retrieved in the previous step.
